opening.argument: The material expressly urges viewers to “invest now” in Wazaba Network and directs them to join through an external link. That appeal pairs a claim that the token could rise from $0.0000001 to equal or exceed Matic with promises of unlimited earnings and referral rewards, including potential earnings of lakhs and crores of Matic. These claims sell the prospect of extraordinary appreciation and earnings to induce investment. The direct invitation to commit money makes this a concrete, deceptive financial solicitation rather than neutral reporting or analysis.
